en:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.note: Accurate, calm button label in the pack register.

en:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.text: If Murage is used only on this computer, and this folder isn't shared with or synced from another computer, choose This is my computer, continue. Murage renames the old lock files beside the folder (it doesn't delete them) and opens again. Your data isn't changed.
en:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.en: If Murage is used only on this computer, and this folder isn't shared with or synced from another computer, choose This is my computer, continue. Murage renames the old lock files beside the folder (it doesn't delete them) and opens again. Your data isn't changed.
en:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.note: Meaning matches, quotes the button label exactly, says nothing is deleted and data is unchanged.

en:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.text: Murage couldn't confirm that nothing else is using this data folder, so it left the lock files as they are. Quit Murage on any other computer that uses this folder, restart this computer, then try again.
en:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.en: Murage couldn't confirm that nothing else is using this data folder, so it left the lock files as they are. Quit Murage on any other computer that uses this folder, restart this computer, then try again.
en:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.note: Accurate, says lock files untouched and what to do, not scary.

de:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.note: Accurate, calm button label in the pack register.

de:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.text: Wenn Murage nur auf diesem Computer verwendet wird und dieser Ordner nicht mit einem anderen Computer geteilt oder von dort synchronisiert wird, wähle Das ist mein Computer, weiter. Murage benennt die alten Sperrdateien neben dem Ordner um (es löscht sie nicht) und öffnet sich erneut. Deine Daten bleiben unverändert.
de:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.en: If Murage is used only on this computer, and this folder isn't shared with or synced from another computer, choose This is my computer, continue. Murage renames the old lock files beside the folder (it doesn't delete them) and opens again. Your data isn't changed.
de:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.note: Meaning matches, quotes the button label exactly, says nothing is deleted and data is unchanged.

de:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.text: Murage konnte nicht bestätigen, dass nichts anderes diesen Datenordner verwendet, und hat die Sperrdateien deshalb unverändert gelassen. Beende Murage auf jedem anderen Computer, der diesen Ordner verwendet, starte diesen Computer neu und versuche es dann erneut.
de:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.en: Murage couldn't confirm that nothing else is using this data folder, so it left the lock files as they are. Quit Murage on any other computer that uses this folder, restart this computer, then try again.
de:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.note: Accurate, says lock files untouched and what to do, not scary.

de:updateRecovery.lease-busy.text: Möglicherweise ist noch eine andere Kopie von Murage geöffnet. Schließe alle anderen Murage-Fenster und wähle dann Start erneut versuchen.
de:updateRecovery.lease-busy.en: Another copy of Murage may still be open. Quit every other Murage window, then choose Retry startup.
de:updateRecovery.lease-busy.note: Matches English, button name is translated consistently with existing pack wording.

hi:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.text: यह मेरा कंप्यूटर है, जारी रखें
hi:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.note: Accurate, calm button label in the pack register.

hi:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.text: अगर Murage सिर्फ़ इसी कंप्यूटर पर इस्तेमाल होता है, और यह फ़ोल्डर किसी दूसरे कंप्यूटर के साथ शेयर या उससे सिंक नहीं होता, तो यह मेरा कंप्यूटर है, जारी रखें चुनें। Murage फ़ोल्डर के पास की पुरानी लॉक फ़ाइलों का नाम बदल देता है (उन्हें मिटाता नहीं) और फिर से खुलता है। आपका डेटा नहीं बदलता।
hi:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.en: If Murage is used only on this computer, and this folder isn't shared with or synced from another computer, choose This is my computer, continue. Murage renames the old lock files beside the folder (it doesn't delete them) and opens again. Your data isn't changed.
hi:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.note: Meaning matches, quotes the button label exactly, says nothing is deleted and data is unchanged.

hi:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.text: Murage पक्का नहीं कर सका कि इस डेटा फ़ोल्डर को कोई और इस्तेमाल नहीं कर रहा, इसलिए उसने लॉक फ़ाइलें वैसी ही छोड़ दीं। इस फ़ोल्डर को इस्तेमाल करने वाले किसी भी दूसरे कंप्यूटर पर Murage बंद करें, इस कंप्यूटर को रीस्टार्ट करें, फिर दोबारा कोशिश करें।
hi:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.en: Murage couldn't confirm that nothing else is using this data folder, so it left the lock files as they are. Quit Murage on any other computer that uses this folder, restart this computer, then try again.
hi:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.note: Accurate, says lock files untouched and what to do, not scary.

hi:updateRecovery.lease-busy.text: Murage की कोई दूसरी कॉपी शायद अब भी खुली है। Murage की बाकी सभी विंडो बंद करें, फिर स्टार्टअप फिर से आज़माएँ चुनें।

ja:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.text: これは自分のコンピュータです。続行
ja:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign.note: Accurate, calm button label in the pack register.

ja:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.text: Murage をこのコンピュータだけで使っていて、このフォルダを他のコンピュータと共有・同期していない場合は、「これは自分のコンピュータです。続行」を選んでください。Murage はフォルダの横にある古いロックファイルの名前を変更し（削除はしません）、もう一度開きます。データは変更されません。
ja:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.en: If Murage is used only on this computer, and this folder isn't shared with or synced from another computer, choose This is my computer, continue. Murage renames the old lock files beside the folder (it doesn't delete them) and opens again. Your data isn't changed.
ja:updateRecovery.set-aside-foreign-note.note: Meaning matches, quotes the button label exactly, says nothing is deleted and data is unchanged.

ja:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.text: このデータフォルダを他に使っているものがないことを Murage が確認できなかったため、ロックファイルはそのままにしました。このフォルダを使っている他のコンピュータで Murage を終了し、このコンピュータを再起動してから、もう一度お試しください。
ja:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.en: Murage couldn't confirm that nothing else is using this data folder, so it left the lock files as they are. Quit Murage on any other computer that uses this folder, restart this computer, then try again.
ja:updateRecovery.LEASE_TAKEOVER_REFUSED.note: Accurate, says lock files untouched and what to do, not scary.

ja:updateRecovery.lease-busy.text: Murage の別のコピーがまだ開いている可能性があります。他の Murage のウィンドウをすべて閉じてから、「起動を再試行」を選んでください。
